scenes.title: One story. Across borders.
scenes.caption: Meet Alex, a fictional designer exploring a role in Hong Kong.

scenes.title: A CV built through conversation
scenes.caption: The agent reads the role and asks for evidence before rewriting.
scenes.screen: CV and job brief on the left. Agent asks about an onboarding project.

chat.text: Tailor my CV for Forma Studio’s Product Designer role.
How was the onboarding result measured?
An internal test: +18% completion. Team of four, six interviews.

scenes.title: Stronger wording. Traceable facts.
scenes.caption: Alex reviews the evidence-linked draft and keeps the internal-test qualifier.
scenes.screen: Before/after CV lines, source references and candidate review.
scenes.draft: Redesigned onboarding with a four-person team, using six interviews to guide prototype iterations. Completion increased by 18% in an internal test.

chat.text: I kept the result qualified as an internal test. Review the source-linked draft before exporting.
That accurately describes my work. Approve this demo version.

scenes.title: The same person. Three languages.
scenes.caption: Switch the recipient preview without changing the facts or public fields.
scenes.screen: English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese profile previews; contact stays private.

chat.text: Create a short profile employers can read before I share my CV.
Here are three versions for review. Contact details are excluded from the public preview.

scenes.title: One role. The right voice for each channel.
scenes.caption: The employer reviews channel-specific drafts with the original job terms intact.
scenes.screen: LinkedIn and Xiaohongshu campaign drafts for the same selected role.

chat.text: Help us explain this role to product designers in Hong Kong and Shenzhen.
I’ll adapt the tone for both channels and keep salary, work style and requirements unchanged.

scenes.title: The agent prepares. Alex decides.
scenes.caption: The ideal assistant fills the company form, then waits for candidate review.
scenes.screen: Simulated official-style careers portal on the left; candidate information and agent on the right.

chat.text: Prepare my application using the CV I just reviewed.
The form is prepared. Please check the details and work-status answer. I will wait for your confirmation.

scenes.confirmation: Demo application prepared and confirmed. No real employer receives it.

scenes.title: Your experience, understood.
scenes.caption: Across connects candidate and employer workflows with review at every handoff.
scenes.screen: Four feature names and end card.
scenes.disclosure: Ideal product concept with fictional data. Some flows go beyond the current prototype. No real messages, posts or applications are sent.
